metadata.description: Personal collection of Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: multi-review
plugins.description: Multi-perspective code review with validation and aggregation

plugins.name: jira-cli
plugins.description: Interact with Jira from the command line using jira-cli

plugins.name: pr-desc-review
plugins.description: Review PR descriptions to ensure they accurately reflect the implementation

plugins.name: claude-cleanup
plugins.description: Clean up stale project entries in ~/.claude.json whose directories no longer exist on disk

plugins.name: git-absorb
plugins.description: Identify and create fixup commits for staged changes using git-absorb

plugins.name: skill-cso-review
plugins.description: Audit SKILL.md files for CSO compliance — checks descriptions, workflow summaries, and structure

plugins.name: logseq
plugins.description: Capture notes, tasks, and insights from Claude conversations directly into Logseq via the graphthulhu MCP server

plugins.name: mac-notifications
plugins.description: macOS sound and system notifications for Claude Code events — plays sounds and shows notifications for Stop, SubagentStop, Notification, and PermissionRequest events

plugins.name: review-pr-comments
plugins.description: Systematically address GitHub PR inline review comments: fetch, evaluate, apply, commit, and summarize

plugins.name: check-pr-comments
plugins.description: Verify whether a reviewer's GitHub PR comments are addressed in code, cross-checked against thread resolution status
